yaml:
scenario: QT_Prolongation_Flag
version: 1.0.0
description: Flag drug-induced QT prolongation based on AHA/ACCF criteria
signals:
  QTc:
    ref: corrected_qt_interval
    expected_unit: ms
    description: Corrected QT interval
    concept_id: 3026258
    concept_code: 8636-3
    vocabulary_id: LOINC
  K:
    ref: potassium
    expected_unit: mEq/L
    description: Serum potassium level
    concept_id: 19049024
    concept_code: '8588'
    vocabulary_id: RxNorm
  Mg:
    ref: magnesium
    expected_unit: mg/dL
    description: Serum magnesium level
    concept_id: 19124906
    concept_code: '6574'
    vocabulary_id: RxNorm
trends:
  qtc_current:
    expr: last(QTc)
    description: Current corrected QT interval
  qtc_baseline:
    expr: first(QTc, 1w)
    description: Baseline corrected QT interval
  qtc_change:
    expr: delta(QTc, 1w)
    description: Change in corrected QT interval from baseline over the last week
  potassium_current:
    expr: last(K)
    description: Current serum potassium level
  magnesium_current:
    expr: last(Mg)
    description: Current serum magnesium level
logic:
  qtc_high:
    when: qtc_current > 500
    severity: high
    description: Corrected QT interval above 500 ms
  qtc_increase:
    when: qtc_change >= 60
    severity: high
    description: Increase in QT interval of 60 ms or more from baseline
  hypokalemia:
    when: potassium_current < 3.5
    severity: medium
    description: Potassium level below 3.5 mEq/L
  hypomagnesemia:
    when: magnesium_current < 1.7
    severity: medium
    description: Magnesium level below 1.7 mg/dL
  qt_concern:
    when: qtc_high OR qtc_increase OR hypokalemia OR hypomagnesemia
    severity: high
    description: Concern for drug-induced QT prolongation
outputs:
  decision:
    has_qt_prolongation:
      type: boolean
      from: logic.qt_concern
      description: Patient flagged for drug-induced QT prolongation risk
  features:
    current_qtc:
      type: float
      from: trends.qtc_current
      description: Current corrected QT interval
    qtc_change_value:
      type: float
      from: trends.qtc_change
      description: Change in QT interval from baseline
  evidence:
    timestamp:
      type: datetime
      expr: evaluation_time()
      description: When this evaluation was performed
warnings: Trend 'qtc_baseline' is defined but not used in any logic rule
